description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Issuance of Certificate of Exemption
categorisation: This gazette notification involves the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka issuing a Certificate of Exemption from licensing requirements under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009. This constitutes a regulatory action and legal notice regarding electricity distribution and supply regulations, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure categories.
